correctness.rationale: At all positive parameters, elimination of resonator variables yields D(t); the free-end boundary gives lambda=K/(K+delta*t) and strictly increasing F_delta. The two bands and all gap/exterior intervals are exhausted by Bloch-factor signs. Boundary thresholds arise from lambda=-1 or +1 and are excluded as non-l2. The double-mode mass criterion follows algebraically. Inversion near each edge proves the quadratic laws. Current package checker verifies three exact symbolic identities, 40 finite-chain comparisons, 40 mode matches, and three edge-law families. Numerical checks are supplemental, not infinite proof.
